sources.citation: Fleck, David W. 2022. Homonimia de etnonimos en la familia Pano. Amazonia Peruana 35: 64-88. Lima: CAAAP. DOI 10.52980/revistaamazonaperuana.vi35.300.
sources.note: No phonology content for this variety. Gives the collection history of the two Castelnau lists (Tabla 1) and lexical-correspondence percentages (Tabla 2: civilises~sauvages 73-88 % = dialects of one language; 51-60 % with Matses; 55-71 % with Mayoruna de Tabatinga; 61-72 % with Jandiatuba), concluding all belong to the Mayoruna branch; the only phonological remark ('importantes diferencias fonologicas') concerns Mayoruna de Tabatinga, and nothing is said about stress, accent or tone of any historical Mayoruna lexicon.
